title: assistant-hub transport wire contract
description: Every shape that crosses the boundary between an assistant-hub core and a transport, in both directions. GENERATED from the zod schemas of @assistant-hub-swarm/transport-sdk — do not edit by hand; run `npm run wire:generate -w @assistant-hub-swarm/transport-sdk`. The manual is at https://github.com/assistant-hub-swarm/ahw-core/blob/main/docs/development/adding-a-transport.md.

AssistantDeletedEvent.title: AssistantDeletedEvent
AssistantDeletedEvent.description: An assistant is gone; stop anything running for it.

ChatInfo.title: ChatInfo
ChatInfo.description: A conversation as the pipeline reads it, named by scoped ref.

ConnectionIdentity.title: ConnectionIdentity
ConnectionIdentity.description: Who a transport's connection is on its platform, as it reports back on every event.

ConversationContext.title: ConversationContext
ConversationContext.description: The history window and participants the core composed for a turn.

DashboardRefreshEvent.title: DashboardRefreshEvent
DashboardRefreshEvent.description: A transport telling the core's dashboard that a page's data changed, so no operator has to reload.

InboundMessageEvent.title: InboundMessageEvent
InboundMessageEvent.description: For reference: what the core's ingest turns one message into — one turn per assistant that can see the chat, with the conversation context composed.

InternalDeleteMessageResponse.title: InternalDeleteMessageResponse
InternalDeleteMessageResponse.description: `deleted: false` means the platform refused — cosmetic for every caller.

InternalSendMenuRequest.title: InternalSendMenuRequest
InternalSendMenuRequest.description: POST /internal/chats/{chatId}/menu — a plain button grid the transport renders however its platform allows.

InternalSentFileResponse.title: InternalSentFileResponse
InternalSentFileResponse.description: The delivered file message's own id.

InternalSentMessageResponse.title: InternalSentMessageResponse
InternalSentMessageResponse.description: The delivered message's own id, verbatim.

InternalSentPhotosResponse.title: InternalSentPhotosResponse
InternalSentPhotosResponse.description: `stored: false` when the photo was sent but its media row could not be kept.

InternalSentVoiceResponse.title: InternalSentVoiceResponse
InternalSentVoiceResponse.description: `asVoice: false` when the platform refused the voice bubble and the text was sent instead.

InternalSetTitleRequest.title: InternalSetTitleRequest
InternalSetTitleRequest.description: PUT /internal/chats/{chatId}/title — only for platforms whose conversations arrive unnamed.

InternalSetTitleResponse.title: InternalSetTitleResponse
InternalSetTitleResponse.description: The title the conversation now carries.

MessageDeliveredEvent.title: MessageDeliveredEvent
MessageDeliveredEvent.description: The transport performed a send. Reported for EVERY send, whoever asked for it — this is how the core learns what is in the chat.

ReplyDeliveryEvent.title: ReplyDeliveryEvent
ReplyDeliveryEvent.description: Published on `assistant-hub:events`: one finished answer to deliver. The whole answer — the transport cuts it to its own limits.

ScopedRef.title: ScopedRef
ScopedRef.description: `source:kind:id` — how one app points at another's entity (`tg:user:12345`). The id is the owning app's own key, verbatim.

SourceId.title: SourceId
SourceId.description: A transport's own id: a short lowercase slug it picks and announces. Becomes the prefix of every scoped ref and the namespace of its MCP tools.

ToolDelivery.title: ToolDelivery
ToolDelivery.description: What a delivery tool reports in `structuredContent` under `delivery`. The core learns a send happened from this shape, never from a tool's name.

TransportBotReactionEvent.title: TransportBotReactionEvent
TransportBotReactionEvent.description: The assistant's own reaction badge, as the platform now shows it.

TransportCallbackRequest.title: TransportCallbackRequest
TransportCallbackRequest.description: POST /api/internal/transports/callback — a feedback-menu button was pressed.

TransportCallbackResponse.title: TransportCallbackResponse
TransportCallbackResponse.description: The toast to answer the platform's callback query with, or null.

TransportConfigChangedEvent.title: TransportConfigChangedEvent
TransportConfigChangedEvent.description: The operator changed something: refetch the desired state and reconcile.

TransportDesiredState.title: TransportDesiredState
TransportDesiredState.description: What the core wants running: one entry per assistant connection, with the operator's config blobs. The answer to registration and to every refetch.

TransportEditEvent.title: TransportEditEvent
TransportEditEvent.description: A message's text changed on the platform.

TransportMessageEvent.title: TransportMessageEvent
TransportMessageEvent.description: A new inbound message — every one the transport sees, addressed or not, with media bytes attached.

TransportMessageLookupResponse.title: TransportMessageLookupResponse
TransportMessageLookupResponse.description: GET /api/internal/transports/messages — does the target message exist in the core's mirror, and is it the assistant's own?

TransportPresenceEvent.title: TransportPresenceEvent
TransportPresenceEvent.description: Which of the transport's connections can see a chat — the core resolves a message's audience from this, never from the transport.

TransportReactionEvent.title: TransportReactionEvent
TransportReactionEvent.description: A person reacted to one of the assistant's messages — what opens the feedback flow.

TransportRegistrationRequest.title: TransportRegistrationRequest
TransportRegistrationRequest.description: POST /api/internal/transports/register — what a transport announces at boot, including the contract major it was built against.

TransportUpdateEvent.title: TransportUpdateEvent
TransportUpdateEvent.description: The queue's payload union: one job per update on `transport-updates`.

TurnLifecycleEvent.title: TurnLifecycleEvent
TurnLifecycleEvent.description: A turn was accepted, is progressing, or settled — render it as the platform's own activity indicator.

TurnToolMeta.title: TurnToolMeta
TurnToolMeta.description: The turn binding the core attaches to every tool call as request `_meta` under `assistant-hub/turn`. Refuse a call that carries none, or one naming another source.
